text:
Neha (CS): FYI - Hightide renewal in 28 days. They want an SLO evidence bundle focused on uptime 99.9% and p95 latency <150ms for the generation route. Can SRE + Data prepare a compact 30d pack + a 1-slide summary for the renewal call? @Sam @Lena
Sam (SRE): On it. Are they hosted or Dedicated?
Ravi (AcctMgr): Dedicated, pinned to eu-west-1. Also asked how credits are computed if we miss p95.
Neha (CS): Deliverables: 1) daily uptime + incident list, 2) latency histogram with p50/p95/p99, 3) sample traces for the two incidents in the last 30d, 4) a sample credit calculation mapped to our SLA table, 5) one customer-facing slide.
Lena (Data): I can pull the metrics. Which job name do I query?
Marco (Sales): Service name is gen-hightide-prod (legacy).
Sam (SRE): I'll export metrics and traces to S3: metrics.csv, traces.tar.gz, incidents.md. ETA EOD tomorrow. Starting export now.
Sam (SRE): PromQL I'm using for p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="gen-hightide-prod"}[5m])) by (le)). Uptime check: sum(up{job="gen-hightide-prod"}) / count(up{job="gen-hightide-prod"}).
Lena (Data): For credits I'll apply: credit = min(0.25 * monthly_fee, (downtime_seconds / total_seconds) * monthly_fee) and produce a sample CSV with scenarios.
Neha (CS): Include our internal latency thresholds: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 500ms. Also add a short note on tail risk and fallback behavior when quantized variants are routed.
Ravi (AcctMgr): I'll set up a rehearsal call Thu 10am PT. @Marco please join for pricing/credits.
Marco (Sales): I'll be there with the renewal deck and provisional credit table.
deploy-bot: Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-cs-packages/hightide/3766123456/ (metrics.csv, traces.tar.gz, incidents.md)
Neha (CS): Action items: Sam upload artifacts; Lena produce metrics.csv + credit_calc.csv; Marco & Ravi run rehearsal; Neha to draft slide. I'll follow up Friday if anything missing. :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): Export progress 20%.
Lena (Data): Starting calculations, will post CSV sample here when ready.
Marco (Sales): Rehearsal invite sent.
Neha (CS): Thanks all. Will close thread once docs are in the S3 folder and slide is ready.
